findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment: Inspector observed an accumulation of soil and food debris on the shield and plunger of the milkshake machine. The PIC was informed and the machine was cleaned and sanitized to sight and touch. Ensure staff are cleaning food contact surfaces frequently to prevent an accumulation of soil.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(A) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment: Observed dish machine to measure 0ppm chlorine. PIC was informed and attempted to trouble-shoot the dish machine with no luck. The triple sink was prepared with detergent and sanitizer for manual washing and sanitizing until the dish machine is repaired. Education was conducted regarding how to set up the triple sink and proper wash, rinse, sanitize practices. Ensure staff are using the triple sink until the dish machine is repaired. A follow-up is scheduled for May 12 to ensure the machine has been repaired.
findings.citation_text: 4-702.11 Before Use After Cleaning. UTENSILS and FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be SANITIZED before use after cleaning.

findings.title: Proper date marking and disposition.
findings.comment:
Observed the following food items to be in use beyond their date marking:
1. Sausage (4/26)
2. Pizza sauce (4/26)

PIC was informed of out-of-date items and the items were discarded. Education was conducted regarding proper date marking practices and what items are considered a time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food. Ensure ready-to-eat TCS foods are discarded 7 days after their date marking for food safety.
findings.citation_text: 3-501.18(A) Ready-to-Eat, Time/Temperature Control for Safety Food, Disposition. (A) A FOOD specified in 3-501.17(A) or (B) shall be discarded if it: (1) Exceeds the temperature and time combination specified in 3-501.17(A), except time that the product is frozen; (2) Is in a container or PACKAGE that does not bear a date or day; or (3) Is inappropriately marked with a date or day that exceeds a temperature and time combination as specified in 3-501.17(A).

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
Observed quaternary ammonia sanitizer solution in kitchen to test at 100 ppm. Solution was remade and tested at 200 ppm Quaternary Ammonia. 

4-501.114: Chemical sanitizer for manual or mechanical operation shall meet proper criteria: (A) chlorine shall have minimum temperature (55F), concentration (100ppm), and pH (10). (B) Iodine shall have 68F, pH of 5 or less and concentration of 12.5ppm and 25ppm. (C) Quaternary ammonium shall have 75F, concentration based on label, and water with 500ppm hardness or less. (D) - (E) Meets EPA-label use and regulatory authority approval. (P) (F) Other chemical sanitzers in-use shall have EPA-registered label, display device registration number on devide and is operated and maintained in accordance with manufacturers instructions (Pf)

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
Observed containers on rack across from dish machine used to store clean utensils and lids to be soiled with food debris. Containers were emptied and cleaned during inspection. 

4-602.13: NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues.

findings.comment: Seal wall to floor behind fryer
